description: This Java class 'SavingsSchedularInterestPoster' handles posting interest to savings accounts, updating related journal entries, and managing savings account transactions within the Fineract platform. It includes methods for batch updating savings account summaries, transactions, and journal entries, and interacts with database and platform services.

classes.name: SavingsSchedularInterestPoster
classes.description: A service class responsible for posting interest to savings accounts, updating journal entries, and managing related transactions within the Fineract platform.

methods.name: postInterest
methods.description: Main method to post interest to all savings accounts, handling errors and batch updates.

methods.name: batchUpdateJournalEntries
methods.description: Batch inserts journal entries for savings account transactions into the database.

methods.name: batchQueryForJournalEntries
methods.description: Returns SQL query string for inserting journal entries.

methods.name: fetchTransactionsFromIds
methods.description: Retrieves transaction data for given reference numbers.

methods.name: batchUpdate
methods.description: Performs batch updates for savings account summaries and transactions, and updates journal entries.

methods.name: batchQueryForTransactionInsertion
methods.description: Returns SQL query string for inserting savings account transactions.

methods.name: batchQueryForSavingsSummaryUpdate
methods.description: Returns SQL query string for updating savings account summaries.

methods.name: batchQueryForTransactionsUpdate
methods.description: Returns SQL query string for updating savings account transactions.
